fusion_findings.finding: F2 already has one logical browser/structural/<target_id> source. External primary evidence does not justify splitting it into competing persistent sources; the useful choice is which capture subtype populates that source for a given evidence need.

CDP Accessibility exposes interaction-oriented semantic structure: role, accessible name/description/value, widget and focus/selection states, DOM backend linkage and frame identity, with full-depth-bounded, partial and query APIs.
CDP DOMSnapshot exposes the full flattened DOM plus layout and selected style/rectangle/paint information, and therefore covers evidence that AX cannot represent exactly.

Schema breadth is not a benchmark. Although AX permits narrower retrieval and DOMSnapshot returns a richer full-document surface, no token/bytes/latency/CPU/RSS efficiency credit is granted until exact target-browser measurements exist. CDP also explicitly warns that Accessibility.enable can impact performance while enabled.

Best-supported E2 hypothesis is AX-first structural capture for interaction semantics, with deterministic escalation to DOMSnapshot only when exact DOM attributes, layout/style/rectangles, AX ambiguity or an explicit downstream contract requires richer structure.

preserved_invariants: CDP target/session/frame identities remain typed and distinct
each observation has its own monotonic capture time
capture broker and temporal fusion remain existing authorities
browser structure remains observational candidate data only
deterministic_dom_escalation: AX absent/ignored/ambiguous while rendered evidence remains relevant
semantic AX state must be cross-checked against underlying DOM/layout
architecture_delta.anti_overbuild: Do not add a second browser service or mandatory browser automation framework merely to implement this policy.

counterhypotheses: High fallback frequency can erase any savings and make AX-first slower/more complex.
AX computation or persistent enablement can cost more than DOMSnapshot at the target cadence.
Accessibility-poor pages can make AX too incomplete for primary structural perception.
A thinner direct DOM projection can outperform both candidates.
acceptance_measurements: browser CPU/RSS under stateless AX and persistent Accessibility.enable modes
semantic task coverage and fallback rate

handoff.instruction: Benchmark AX-first versus DOMSnapshot on the exact target browser/runtime before making it a default production policy. Preserve the same browser/structural source and the previously fused CDP provenance hardening contract.
